subject: 3-way marketplace demo: Nimbus SI + AWS + Redwood — slot negotiation
messages:
From: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@nimbus-sys.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Partner Rep <aws-partner-link@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + proposed windows for joint AWS Marketplace demo (Nimbus + Redwood)

Hi Aditya / Vivek,

Thanks again for the quick intro yesterday. Nimbus is ready to do a joint demo focused on our integration workflow and the AWS Marketplace listing flow — AWS would like to attend to confirm marketplace steps and the listing timeline.

High-level ask: can we lock a 45-minute window in the next two weeks for a technical + pricing runthrough and to review Marketplace listing roles? We expect the following attendees:
- Nimbus: Sarah Cho (sales), Miguel Torres (tech lead)
- AWS: AWS Partner Rep (channel/contact)
- Redwood: Aditya + a product/solutions engineer (TBD)

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue May 5, 10:00–10:45am PT
- Thu May 7, 2:00–2:45pm PT
- Mon May 11, 9:30–10:15am PT

I attached a short agenda + what Nimbus wants to cover (Attachment: nimbus-MVP-agenda.pdf (PDF)). If none of these work, tell us a couple of available windows and we’ll flex.

Also: a quick ask — can Redwood share the Marketplace preflight checklist or SSOT spreadsheet so Nimbus can prep account details in advance?

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Cho
Senior Partnerships, Nimbus Systems
(Attachment: nimbus-MVP-agenda.pdf)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@nimbus-sys.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, AWS Partner Rep <aws-partner-link@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed windows for joint AWS Marketplace demo (Nimbus + Redwood)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the agenda and clear ask. Happy to host.

Quick notes:
- All three proposed slots work on our side except May 11 morning (we have an internal release review then).
- Can you confirm Miguel’s timezone (looks like PT) and whether you want a live Q&A at the end (recommended — we’ll include a product engineer).

I’m looping Kim (Marketplace PM) to join; she’ll bring the SSOT / preflight checklist. Kim — can you attach the marketplace checklist and a short note on required account permissions?

If AWS can confirm availability, let’s tentatively pencil Tue May 5, 10:00–10:45am PT and I’ll send a calendar invite. If that’s not tenable, Thu May 7, 2:00pm PT is our backup.

Requested next steps:
1) Sarah — confirm final slot and attendees (Miguel + AWS rep).
2) Kim — attach the SSOT + any one-pager we should share ahead.
3) I’ll send the invite with a short run-of-show and join links.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(Company: Redwood Inference)
